probeSelection.source: Baseline geometry and baseline normal attributes only. Candidate scene is never built.

explanation: A finger root starts inside the palm. Longer inner fingers emerge from the palm farther along their length, so a fixed early t deadline omits their near-surface vertices. The 0.34 deadline covers the proximal overlap before the first fold relief begins at t=0.36; 0.36 is the unchanged distal-normal boundary. Count and angular-improvement requirements stay unchanged.
